extracted.name: Duck & plum salad
extracted.description: Pair the winning combination of duck and plums together in this colourful salad. It's a great way to use up a glut of homegrown plums at the end of summer
ingredient_lines: 2 medium carrots sliced into thin, long matchsticks
4 ripe plums halved and sliced into 8 thin wedges
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Put the duck legs in a small roasting tin and rub over the olive oil, Chinese five-spice and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Roast for 1 hr 30 mins-1 hr 45 mins until tender and easily pulled apart. Leave to cool, then shred the meat using two forks.
Put the carrots, spring onions, plums, coriander leaves and peanuts in a bowl and toss to combine. Drizzle in the fish sauce, if using, and the lime juice. Toss again.
Tip the duck meat into a bowl or onto a serving platter, then top with the plum salad to serve.
